animation_prompt_archive.brief: Original hand-painted ink-edged tactical RPG, same face and outfit. Transparent six-column five-row atlas, 30 equal cells, full silhouette with padding, stable feet at 88% height, body centred. Row 1 six restrained idle poses with breathing/scarf motion; row 2 six genuine walk cycle poses with alternating foot contact/down/passing; row 3 physical crouch/windup/sword swing/follow through/recovery; row 4 hit flinch/stagger/brace/recovery; row 5 left-palm casting gather/release/recovery. No labels, grid, shadows, ground or scenery. Reference the first original character only. Requested alpha preserved.

landmarks_prompt: Create four original high-quality hand-painted 2D isometric fantasy tactical RPG LANDMARK PROPS on a perfectly transparent background, in a TWO COLUMN by TWO ROW equal-cell atlas, square overall. Match the mature painterly ink-edged craftsmanship and lighting of the supplied original unit sprites; no characters. Each prop entirely isolated with wide 15 percent transparent padding, stable ground at 90 percent cell height, 3/4 view, key light from upper left, believable material weight and irregular silhouette. No contact sheet labels, no frames, no letters, no writing, no logos. TOP LEFT: WAR CARTOGRAPHY FANTASY broken field survey boundary stone, tall leaning weathered grey-green basalt with chipped crown, inset old brass survey compass, small weather-beaten ivory paper strips tied with wax-red cord, one torn wax-red military pennant, brass sighting ring at top, tide-eroded teal mineral fractures at base. It must be a memorable hand-crafted storytelling object, not a flat outlined obelisk. TOP RIGHT: WAR CARTOGRAPHY FANTASY compact wooden tide gauge and survey station, tripod surveying instrument with brass telescope, rolled ivory charts, red wax seal ribbons, one small wind-torn red surveying pennant and stacked field cases; no text. BOTTOM LEFT: EMBER PILGRIMAGE alternative direction, tall asymmetrical charcoal basalt arch with hanging old brass lantern on a curved wrought iron arm, warm amber glass, dark carved recesses and chipped rock, two hanging ivory cloth votive strips, ceremonial bronze rivets; no religion symbols or writing. BOTTOM RIGHT: EMBER PILGRIMAGE low weathered black stone ceremonial brazier with five uneven basalt fins, old copper bowl of softly glowing ember coals and a tiny flame, pale ash, one bronze offering chain. These are two art direction candidates for the SAME ferry battlefield, not finalized lore. Four full props, clear negative space between all cells, top pair cooler brass/teal/wax-red, bottom pair charcoal/amber/ivory. Extremely polished painted materials, subtle edges, excellent readable silhouette at 140px, no scenery or floor patches. Avoid line-only vector art, flat geometric diagram shapes, neon gradients or glossy 3D rendering.
